title: GraphSnapshotLine
description:
Every line of a snapshot body after the header: the nodes in id order, then the edges in
(`from`, `kind`, `to`, `detail`) order.

GraphEdge.description:
One relation. `to` may be a node of another source, or a `map:<id>` reference; an edge whose
target is not in a copy yet is kept and resolves when it is.

kind.description: One of [`kind::edge`], or a later kind this reader keeps without knowing it.

GraphNode.description:
One thing the graph knows about. No file contents: for code a name, a path, a line range and
one signature line; for a decision document its capped Decision section (ADR 0084).

detail.description: What else this kind carries. Never a progress state and never a session.

kind.description: One of [`kind::node`], or a later kind this reader keeps without knowing it.

repo.description: `owner/name`, where the node belongs to one repository.

summary.description: One line a search may match and show: a signature, a title, a description.
